visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with three small Chiikawa plushies—Usagi in a chef hat, Chiikawa, and Hachiware—seen from a rear perspective on a light brown tiled floor. A white fan stands in the background with blue denim fabric draped over its pole, while the camera zooms in slightly to emphasize the soft white texture and red ball chains of the dolls. (2) There is a quick cut to a frontal close-up showing only the Usagi chef and Chiikawa plushies sitting side-by-side. A tiny brown plastic bowl is placed on the floor between them, suggesting a miniature dining or cooking scene. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor home environment. (3) The scene shifts back to the rear view of the three plushies, but now a real white cat with brown patches on its head and back is sitting upright directly in front of them. The cat gazes curiously at the row of toys, with household items like cardboard boxes and a suitcase visible in the cluttered background. (4) The cat leans its head down to sniff the plushies before suddenly opening its mouth and biting the Usagi chef doll. The cat stands up and turns toward the left, firmly gripping the white plush toy in its jaws as the other two dolls remain static on the tiles. (5) The camera tracks the cat as it trots away quickly into a dark hallway, carrying the kidnapped plushie. The movement is slightly shaky as the camera follows the animal past more boxes and a luggage handle, ending as the cat disappears further into the interior of the house.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: No humans visible; only 1 cat and 3 plush dolls.

The production is clean with a high spectral centroid, creating a warm and lighthearted atmosphere as the song progresses through its first verse. (2) The singing continues steadily with no interruption from environmental noise or sound effects. The tempo is consistent at approximately 120 BPM, and the melodic contour is positive and energetic. The audio maintains a studio-quality clarity with a high signal-to-noise ratio, suggesting a post-produced musical overlay. (3) In the final segment, a new vocal event occurs as a person shouts "Hey, hey, hey!" in a rapid, high-arousal tone over the music. This sudden verbal outburst is loud and rhythmic, coinciding with the cat's movement. The acoustic pop music remains audible beneath this exclamation until the video cuts off.
